metadata.title: Evaluate to true if the unix-def:symlink_test is properly supported

criterion.comment: Resolve multiple daisy chained links. Should produce statuses filepath 'exists' and canonical_path 'exists.'
Attempt to resolve a regular file (not a link). Should produce statuses of 'dne' with result of 'false', negating to return 'true'
Attempt to resolve a filepath that does not exist. Expect a test result of 'false', negating to return 'true'
Resolve a simple working symbolic link. Expect 'true'.

metadata.title: Evaluate to error if the unix-def:symlink_test is properly supported

criterion.comment: Attempt to resolve a circular link. Should produce filepath status of 'exists' and canonical path status of 'error'
Attempt to resolve a broken link. Should produce filepath status of 'exists' and canonical path status of 'error and test result of 'error'.'

symlink_test.comment: Expected Result: 'true'. Resolve a working chain of links.
Expected Result: 'error'. Resolve a circular link.
Expected Result: 'false'(negates to 'true' in criterion). Resolve a regular file.
Expected Result: 'error'. Resolve a broken link.
Expected Result: 'false'(negates to 'true' in criterion). Resolve a non-existent file.
Expected Result: 'true'. Resolve a working symbolic link.

symlink_object.comment: Attempt to resolve a circular link.
Attempt to resolve a regular file.
Attempt to resolve a broken link.
Attempt to resolve a non-existent file.
